textOffCanvas.evidence: Preparation records, per text state, the settled glyph-ink box of each line (union of shaped cluster ink boxes; no text-animator excursions, container or decorations). Exposed as preview.textInkBounds and passed to analyzeCompositionQuality as runtime evidence (policy.textFramingEvidence, never saved).
textOffCanvas.measure: On each visible frame the line boxes are projected by the sample's matrix (or homography), so parents and precomp hosts count. measured = area outside the canvas / total area, reported when it reaches textOffCanvasFraction (policy, default 0.05). Precomp text uses its precomp-id/layer-id key.
textOffCanvas.alignContract: When the layer's align is center or right, the message states that align places each line relative to the layer origin, not within textLayout.width.
textOffCanvas.notCovered: State-only lint measures no glyph ink and adds nothing (unchanged reports). Text without a pinned font is not measured. A text-animator entrance is not reported, and neither are frames on which the layer is in transit by its own transform (within 0.5 s, in the same shot, of the hidden share changing by more than 0.5 per second between adjacent visible frames; added after the PR #66 review). A title that settles cut off is reported from 0.5 s after it settles; a slow drift across the edge is still reported.

orphanedDecoration.measure: For root and precomp text layers with decorations, the analysis asks, on each frame it already samples (one pass; the evidence is a probe since the PR #66 review), the prepared text (typographyOrphanedDecorations) which decorations paint while every glyph they decorate (their span, if any) is transparent through text-animator opacity, a word reveal or the layer reveal. It uses the renderer's own draw plan, transitions included. path names the decoration (layers.N.decorations.M).
orphanedDecoration.fix: Opt-in decoration field fadeWithText (composition schema): the mark's alpha is multiplied by the highest animator opacity of its non-blank glyphs on each line. Off by default; existing compositions render unchanged.

rejectedExperiments.experiment: Measure the off-frame share from the evaluator's text bounds (the measured motion-union bounds).
rejectedExperiments.reason: Those bounds include every reachable text-animator excursion, so a glyph entrance from below or a tracking drift would count as off-frame on every frame. Settled per-line ink boxes were used instead.

rejectedExperiments.experiment: Make every decoration follow its text's opacity by default.
rejectedExperiments.reason: Changes existing renders (story and commerce typography share the decoration path); kept opt-in as fadeWithText and paired with a default lint finding.

limitations: Both rules need pixel lint (--pixels true); state-only lint has no glyph measurements.
text-off-canvas uses axis-aligned line boxes, not glyph outlines; rotated or projected lines use their screen bounding box.
A decoration over a run of only spaces counts as orphaned only by its own glyphs; its fadeWithText alpha is 0 on such a line.
